actions.hint: Scripts run in viewers that support JavaScript; Folitecta does not run them. An empty script removes the action.
actions.title: Document actions
calendar.open: Choose the date on a calendar
field.auto_size: 0 fits the text to the field
field.calc.no_fields: The document has no other fields to calculate from.
field.calc_order.hint: Fields are calculated from the top: each one sees the values calculated before it.
field.calc_order.none: No field of the document is calculated. Choose a calculation in the properties of a text field.
field.caption: Caption
field.check_custom_hint: A validation script written by hand checks the value (under Scripts).
field.format_custom_hint: The field formats its value with scripts written by hand: they are under Scripts. Choosing a format here replaces them.
field.name: Name
field.no_items: No items yet: type one and add it.
field.scripts.hint: JavaScript run by the field. A calculate script sets event.value; a format script changes the text shown; a validate script refuses a value with event.rc = false.
field.title: Form field
fieldcopies.hint: Copies get the field name followed by a number. Rows go down the page, columns to the right.
fieldcopies.title: Create multiple copies
fields.manual_hint: Manual tab order: move the fields of each page with the arrows.
fields.manual_option: Arrange the tab order by hand
fields.options.title: Fields pane options
js.changes_off: The script asked to change the document, but changes are turned off in the JavaScript options
js.hint: Ctrl+Enter runs the code. Scripts run apart from the window and stop after the time set in the options; field values, the current page and the document information they change are applied to the document.
js.no_doc_scripts: The document has no named scripts.
js.no_snippets: No snippets yet: save the code of the editor as a snippet to reuse it.
js.open_action_note: The document also runs a script when it opens; it is listed under Document actions.
js.output_empty: What scripts print and return shows here.
js.prefs_hint: Scripts run only when you start them from the console; scripts inside documents are never run when a document opens.
js.select_code: Select some code in the editor first
js.timeout_msg: The script was stopped after {secs} s
launch.hint: Arguments are separated by spaces; use double quotes for arguments with spaces. Macros are replaced with the details of the current view. Without a program the document opens in the system's PDF application.
launch.title: Launch application
